specification.hypothesis: Recently resolved own and peer errors of the frozen nonlinear predictor reveal track-level and driver-level drift not represented by raw lap differences.
specification.population: Exactly the original matched next-eligible-lap issuances, not later checkpoints. No prediction time or target changes.
specification.baseline: Fixed hgb_l15_i150 hyperparameters; fit2022 for selection2023, unchanged production2022-23 fit for transfer.
specification.online_information: A residual becomes visible only at its target timestamp. Own residual at current timestamp is allowed; peer residuals must be strictly earlier. Only resolved same-stint targets update residual state. Own state resets on issuance stint-generation changes. Latest peer residual per driver within180seconds and2laps; event state starts empty.
specification.residual_training: Expanding2022 blocks: first6events train base/next5events score; first11/next5; first16/last6. Meta-model sees only these cross-fit residuals. Final residual fit adds2023 base predictions made by a2022-only fit. No transfer outcomes fit any static model; online state updates from already observed outcomes are part of the frozen predictor.
specification.selection: Exactly8 candidates. Select minimum event-balanced2023MAE; deterministic lexicographic name tie break. Persist selection lock before transfer loading. If validation gain below0.5percent, reject cycle without opening transfer table.
specification.uncertainty: 20000 paired event and circular3-event bootstrap replicates; event-balanced means; seed20260908. All2024-26dates already exposed historically, so intervals are descriptive, not confirmation after repeated search.
specification.runtime_limitations: Same recorded eligibility/input availability convention as current production. Retrospectively reconstructed flags are not proof of original feed receipt times. No calibrated interval or strategy/RL reward claim.
specification.source_interpretation: Motivation for forgetting and sequential adaptive regression; custom residual state features and HGB/Huber implementation, not a reproduction of either paper's algorithm or theorem.
specification.suggested_commit: research(f1-live): test causal online residual assimilation
